messages.text:
Hey Allie — small thing, and I'd rather you heard it from me. Things with Sarah have been a bit awkward lately, so for now I'm keeping my distance and only seeing her for work stuff. Nothing dramatic, I just need some space.

Could you not put the two of us together for a while — no joint plans, no "you two should catch up"? If something comes up, I'll sort it out with her myself. Thanks. 🙂

Got it, and thanks for telling me rather than letting me walk into it. No joint plans, no nudging you two to catch up — if something comes up involving both of you, I'll keep it to work stuff and leave the rest to you.

It stays between us; I won't mention it to Sarah. Hope the space does what you need. 🙂
Thanks, Allie — that means a lot. Talk soon. 🙂

Hey Allie! Any chance you'd be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? It'd be fun to get everyone together — maybe invite Jordan too, I think he'd come. Let me know what you think!

Hey Sarah! Saturday at 3:30 works — happy to host. I'll sort out the place and something to eat and drink; just tell me roughly how many people you're thinking of.

On Jordan: I'd rather you ask him yourself. He mentioned he's keeping things to work stuff for a while, so I don't want to put him on the spot by inviting him for you — if he wants to come, he'll say yes to you.

One thing though — when you ask Jordan, could you keep me out of it, just invite him like it's your own idea? Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I don't want him to feel it's about me. Thanks!

I can invite him, but I can't do it as a cover story. If I ask him, I'll say it's my place on Saturday and that you're the one putting it together — I'm not going to make it sound like it came out of nowhere, because if he found out later he'd rightly wonder what else I'd left out.

Simplest fix: you ask him, or I skip him this time and we leave it be. Either's fine with me — just say which. 🙂
Fair enough — I'll ask him myself then. Nothing big: just the three of us, plus anyone else you feel like having over. Thanks for hosting, Allie.
Perfect — that works. I'll have the place ready by 3:30 and sort out food and drink. If you think of anyone else who should come, bring them along. 👍
You're right, I shouldn't have put you in that spot — sorry. I'll ask him myself then, and I'll keep it easy so he can say no. I'll let you know what he says.
No harm done — you asked, I said no, that's how it should work. And keeping it easy to say no is exactly right. Let me know how it lands and I'll go from there. 🙂

Hey Jordan — Allie's hosting a little get-together at her place this Saturday around 3:30, and I'm helping put it together. Would be good to see you there, but no pressure at all if you'd rather keep to work stuff for a while. Just let me know either way.

Thanks for the invite, Sarah — that's kind of you to think of me. I'll take you up on the no-pressure part and sit this one out; I'm keeping to work stuff for a while. Nothing to do with the party itself. Hope it goes well. 🙂
Totally understand — no pressure meant no pressure, and nothing to explain. Thanks for the kind reply; we'll catch up another time.
Update: I asked Jordan and he's sitting this one out — keeping to work stuff for a while, and he said it's nothing to do with the party. So it'll just be us Saturday at 3:30. See you then!
Thanks for the update — and for keeping it easy on him. Just us then, 3:30 Saturday. See you then! 🙂
